name: Webel Purulia data centre / data storage facility
developer: West Bengal Electronics Industry Development Corporation Limited (Webel)
notes: Telegraph India reported on 2025-01-11 that Webel already runs two similar data-storage centres in Calcutta and Purulia while opening its Siliguri data centre. Webel tender archives refer to establishment of high-performance data center infrastructure at Monibhandar and DR site Purulia; a West Bengal PHE progress page also lists Webel migration/upgradation work against Purulia. Capacity not disclosed.

No division-specific datacenter project found in public searches. West Bengal Data Centre Policy mentions Falta EMC as an ancillary electronics/manufacturing cluster supporting new data centres, but not as a data-centre project. The PHE page lists statewide migration/upgradation of a central smart data centre across districts, including South 24 Parganas, not a local South 24 Parganas facility.

No division-specific datacenter project found in public searches for Uttar Dinajpur/Raiganj/Islampur. Airtel/Nxtra source references Kolkata data centre construction and nearby network/telecom locations, not a Uttar Dinajpur facility. The PHE page lists statewide migration/upgradation of a central smart data centre across districts, including Uttar Dinajpur, not a local Uttar Dinajpur facility.
